newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov internal aluminium sales up 23.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov internal aluminium sales up 23.8 pct.

text.p: Brazilian internal sales of all primary aluminium reached 18,200 tonnes in November, up 23.8 percent from the 14,700 tonnes sold in November 1995, said the Brazilian Aluminium Association (ABAL).
Even with the traditional drop-off in sales expected in December, total sales are forecast to reach 197,700 tonnes, exceeding the 1995 total of 190,600 tonnes by 3.7 percent.
The November figure was unchanged from that in October, which registered a 26.4 percent rise on the corresponding month in 1995.
Total sales in the first eleven months of 1996 were 183,100 tonnes, an overall rise of 2.7 percent on the 178,200 tonnes sold in January/November 1995.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
